Hey Amy, LeBella's customer customer, I don't know the customer number, it's LeBella's fine wine and spirits, you find it and make it happen please. Hey Amy, I don't have an order. I'm just looking for an ETA on the following item number. It's item number one, three, two, two, four. The item is, it's a Jean-Marc Crochet Sans-Cé at 2023. Is that still in port in France or on the water or give me your best? Thanks. Bye.
